goals.title: Goals
goals.description: Goals offered by Run Maven › Other Goal…, separated by commas or new lines. Each entry may hold several goals and options (clean install -DskipTests).
goals.default: clean, validate, compile, test, package, verify, install, deploy, clean install, dependency:tree

extraArgs.title: Extra arguments
extraArgs.description: Added to every run before the goals, e.g. -o or -T 1C.

debugPort.title: Debug port
debugPort.description: Debug Maven makes the JVMs Maven starts for tests (Surefire, Failsafe) and spring-boot:run wait for a debugger on this port; attach with a Remote JVM Debug configuration.
